28:     };
29:

31:       assertEquals(pair[1], FieldNamingPolicy.separateCamelCase(pair[0], '_'));
32:     }
33:   }

36:   public void testUpperCaseFirstLetter() {

39:       { "a", "A" },

41:       { "AB", "AB" },
42:       { "_a", "_A" },
43:       { "_ab", "_Ab" },
44:       { "__", "__" },
45:       { "_1", "_1" },
46:       // Not a letter, but has uppercase variant (should not be uppercased)
47:       // See https://github.com/google/gson/issues/1965
48:       { "\u2170", "\u2170" },
49:       { "_\u2170", "_\u2170" },
50:       { "\u2170a", "\u2170A" },
51:     };

55:     }
